in_text_mentions: The patient was a boy with congenital hydronephrosis who had undergone ultrasonography every month for follow-up. At 4 months of age, ultrasonography incidentally showed an intra-abdominal cyst. Computerized tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography revealed congenital biliary dilatation (5-cm type Ia [Todani classification]) ( Fig. 1A, B ). A definitive pancreaticobiliary maljunction and bile duct anomaly were not detected preoperatively. At 7 months of age, we performed extrahepatic bile duct resection and hepaticojejunostomy with a five-port layout.
